text: Eochaid Fedlech ruled as king of Tara. His daughters were famed for their splendor. They were Medb, Clothra, Eithne, Éle, and Mugain. The sons numbered four. They were Furbaide and three boys, each named Finn. The three shared the name Finn Emna. Eochaid had a brother named Eochaid Airem. The two may in truth have been one man, since both were said to wed Étain. The naming of all those sons shows a family fond of a single title.
